findings.class: liveness false negative (fail-closed); no false PASS
findings.confidence: HIGH: the gateway arithmetic is source-proven and the defect is witnessed on the frozen drain() bytes under both Pythons
source_evidence: gateway.py 456, 467: projected_cost = current_admitted_cost + request_cost; current_admitted_cost = projected_cost

gateway.py 517-521: current_in_flight = max(0, n - 1); current_admitted_cost = max(0.0, current_admitted_cost - request_cost). There is no reset to exactly 0.0 at idle, and a grep shows no other writes (gateway-cost-grep02.log)
gateway.py 165, 294, 838: the gateway compares its own cost ledger with math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-9)
native_services_smoke.py 585e606f 81-82, 87: the actual run uses ADMISSION_MODE=cost_aware, MAX_ADMITTED_COST=32, MPC_LAB_ENABLED=true, OUTPUT_TOKEN_COST=0.0052083333, MIN_REQUEST_COST=0.1
gateway.py 37, 385: request cost is floored at MIN_REQUEST_COST (default 0.1)
findings.mechanism: When two or more admitted requests overlap, (a + b) - a need not equal b in binary floating point. The remaining subtraction can leave a positive residue; a negative residue is clipped to 0.0 by max(). Example: costs 0.1 and 0.2 admitted together leave 2.7755575615628914e-17 after both finish, in FIFO or LIFO order. Sequential non-overlapping requests return exactly 0.0.
effect: Pre-episode drain, after the 3-request warmup: if a residue is present it never succeeds. Each reading (every <= 50 ms) costs one GET, one evidence file and one in-memory caller_observations entry, until remaining() refuses at D - R. collect() then fails NOT_RUN at stage pre_episode_drain with no episode traffic, consuming the GPU lease.
Final drain, after a possibly valid 5-request episode: the same spin, after which failure('final_drain') makes the receipt FAILED (or adds a note) even though the episode collected correctly.
No false PASS: the counters remain exact, and the fallback check is unaffected.
findings.actual_run_probability: UNKNOWN. It depends on how much the warmup and Train probe requests actually overlap and on the actual token-derived costs; the probe inputs were deliberately not read. On synthetic costs, 10 of 120 five-request finish orders and 2 of 20 pairs left a positive residue (W1).

The value is already validated as finite and >= 0 at 108-109, so <= 1e-9 is equivalent to abs(x) <= 1e-9. DRAIN_FIELDS stays as it is for the validation at 107.

findings.confidence: HIGH on mechanism (pathlib Path.mkdir() without exist_ok raises FileExistsError); the trigger depends on module import order. Static reasoning; not executed.
findings.effect: If the qualification test module is imported before the smoke test module in one process with the same NATIVE_SMOKE_TEST_OUTPUT, the smoke module's import-time ROOT.mkdir() raises FileExistsError and causes a collection error. Name-sorted directory collection does this, because test_native_nominal_qualification.py sorts before test_native_services_smoke.py. The Mayor's composed runner lists the smoke test first and passed. There is no source or product effect.
findings.smallest_fix: Give the qualification test its own output root (a separate env var, or a sibling directory not nested under the smoke ROOT). Alternatively, record 'smoke test module first, fresh output dir' as a precondition of the portable/package runner.

observations_nonblocking.text: Drain evidence volume (files and report entries) is bounded only by time, not by count. After the F1 fix a drain typically needs one to a few readings. A cap or summary is optional.
The counter check accepts float 0.0 (type in (int, float)). The gateway counters are ints; this is harmless.
The B3-2 gap: the started flag is absent from the not-run receipt. Optional.
SHOULD L1 (S - now per stage) is not recorded.

offered_requests_from_driver counts the episode's allocated offered placeholders (client 347-348), not transmitted requests, and excludes the warmup (separate warmup_* keys). Consumers must not read it as transmitted or as total driver traffic.

If warmup capture persistence fails on the success path, the same error is recorded twice (warmup_capture_persistence via preserving, then warmup_replay via failure), and the receipt stage reads warmup_replay. The first caller_errors entry is the precise one.

A StopIteration from next() at 205 would leave the coroutine as RuntimeError (coroutine StopIteration rule), although the receipt records StopIteration. This is unreachable when smoke ownership contains an engine service.
The unkeyed model-binding.json write (207-213) predates this change and contains no secret.

The caller self-hash reads file bytes, not loaded code. The Mayor's composed runner wrote py312 pyc files into resume-mvp/__pycache__ (no -B), so the package build must exclude __pycache__ and the launch should use -B or PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

At runtime the caller hash-checks only the caller, adapter and protocol. Client, runtime, permit, planner, metrics, mpc_lab, smoke, services and gateway rely on the package build and the B1 prereg pins.

witnesses.purpose: Show that the frozen drain() cannot succeed on a zero-counter, positive float-residue /metrics response, and that gateway-style arithmetic produces such residues.

observations.residue_case: Frozen drain() with httpx MockTransport serving counters 0, fallback 0 and cost 2.7755575615628914e-17 made 10 GETs and wrote 11 evidence files in about 0.50 s of the granted budget, then raised ProbeError('original work deadline exhausted'). No caller_drains entry was recorded.
observations.zero_control: The same harness with cost 0.0 drained after 1 reading.
observations.replica_arithmetic: SYNTHETIC literal costs, not gateway execution. 0.1 and 0.2 overlapped leave 2.7755575615628914e-17 in FIFO and LIFO order. 10 of 120 five-request finish orders and 2 of 20 pairs leave 4.440892098500626e-16. Sequential non-overlap gives exactly 0.0.
observations.isolation: Run with -B -I -X pycache_prefix=<unused capsule dir>, nice -n19, timeout 60, single-thread env, PYTHONPATH unset. No pycache was written. Pins were unchanged before and after.
